entities.name: Scholasticism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Medieval intellectual movement (c. 1100–1500) that sought to reconcile classical philosophy (especially Aristotle) with Christian theology through rigorous logical argument. It dominated European universities and laid foundations for the scientific method.
